description_en: Queries the information about the retry log of a Spark application
name: GetSparkAppAttemptLog

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the log.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455887.html operation to query the information about the retry attempts of a Spark application, including the retry log IDs
parameters.help_zh:
重试日志的ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455887.html接口查询应用的重试历史信息，包含重试日志ID
parameters.name: attempt_id

parameters.help_en: The number of log entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 重试日志的行数。取值范围：1~500，默认值为300
parameters.name: log_length

parameters.help_zh: 读取日志的其实偏移量
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
DBClusterId.description_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
